title: Lovalingo
description: A discontinued localization tool for AI-built web apps that reached around six paying users before native i18n made differentiation difficult.
body:
Lovalingo was a translation and localization tool for AI-built web apps. It reached around six paying users, but finding a sustainable product-market fit proved difficult. The project has been discontinued.

## Why we stopped

AI web-coding tools increasingly offered translation and internationalization natively. That made it harder to establish a distinct, durable reason to use a separate localization product. We decided not to continue the business.

## What was built

Lovalingo covered more than text translation: locale routes, metadata, sitemaps, translated-page discovery, billing, and a dashboard showing translation and live-page status.

The implementation included retry handling, route and configuration preservation, domain adoption, and checks intended to distinguish a completed translation job from a correctly published multilingual page.

## What we learned

A useful feature and early paying users are not the same as a defensible standalone product. The work remains part of the portfolio as a completed product experiment, not an active service or roadmap.
